Consequently F(V)=downarrow{C(y):y false}; all 2^k signatures have nonempty cells exactly when all n_i>=2, so all order ideals are attainable. For maximal antichain A=Max(F), cells outside F are forced true, maximal cells require a false point, lower cells are free: multiply 2^m and (2^m-1) to get exact fibers. Bernoulli independence yields the t formula; grand-only profile maximal [k]\{i} yields t prod_i(1-t^(n_i-1)); log expansion gives e^-lambda under t^(n-1)->0. Removing empty coalition identifies exactly two ideals. Independent exhaustive 2x2x2 valuation test recovered 20 profiles among all 256 valuations. Finite check not the proof.
